name: Sean Ryan

sponsored.t: Raises the minimum fee for temporary interpreters
sponsored.sum: Raises the minimum fee for temporary interpreters; requires that town and village courts share in the compensation of such temporary interpreters.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 110 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 916, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the judiciary law, in relation to requiring town and village courts compensate temporary interpreters for deaf or hard of hearing persons" NOT APPROVED This bill would increase the reimbursement counties must provide town and village courts for temporary court interpreter fees from $25 per day to $110, shifting the cost of providing services from one unit of local government to the other. Issues regarding cost sharing among local governments should be addressed in the State Budget process where aid to localities can be considered. Therefore, I am constrained to veto this legislation. The bill is disapproved. (signed) KATHY HOCHUL __________

sponsored.t: Relates to manufactured homes certificate of title and the conveyance and encumbrance of manufactured homes as real property
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York land-home property act"; relates to manufactured homes certificate of title and the conveyance and encumbrance of manufactured homes as real property.
sponsored.fis: State and local governments will likely benefit since the manufactured home converted to real estate will likely be worth more than before so property taxes collected will increase.

sponsored.t: Relates to orders of protection in child abuse and neglect proceedings in family court
sponsored.sum: Relates to orders of protection in child abuse and neglect proceedings in family court.

sponsored.t: Designates the Scajaquada heritage area
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Designates the Scajaquada heritage area as a state designated heritage area.

sponsored.t: Facilitates the marketing of any issue of serial bonds or notes of the city of Buffalo issued on or before a certain date
sponsored.sum: Facilitates the marketing of any issue of serial bonds or notes of the city of Buffalo issued on or before June 30, 2026.
sponsored.fis: None to the State. This bill provides financial benefits to the City of Buffalo.

sponsored.t: Adds employee-owned enterprises to the list of preferred contractors for public contracts in the state
sponsored.sum: Adds employee-owned enterprises and worker cooperatives to the list of preferred contractors for public contracts in the state; authorizes such enterprises and cooperatives to make certain purchases from centralized contracts for commodities, subject to conditions of the office of general services; authorizes the comptroller to conduct certain audits of employee-owned enterprises and worker cooperatives.

sponsored.t: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"; provides that each laborer, worker or mechanic in the employ of a contractor who by request or permission of an employer reports for work on any day shall be paid no less than four hours at the prevailing rate of wages.

sponsored.t: Provides alternative retirement benefits for the police force at Erie County Medical Center
sponsored.sum: Provides alternative retirement benefits for the police force at Erie County Medical Center; provides a qualifying member shall receive a retirement allowance consisting of a pension equal to one-fiftieth of their final average salary for each year of qualifying creditable service.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing notice to elected officials upon receipt of an application for a liquor license
sponsored.sum: Requires the state liquor authority to provide notice to state legislative representatives upon receipt of an application for a liquor license in their district.

sponsored.t: Reduces tuition rates for certain Olympic athletes
sponsored.sum: Reduces tuition rates of out of state Olympic athletes who represented Team USA.

sponsored.t: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises to 2026
sponsored.sum: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises from June 30, 2025 to June 30, 2026; extends for one year the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises which is tasked with reporting and making recommendations on how best to support such businesses and promote the formation and growth of new employee-owned enterprises in New York state.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the discontinuance of certain parklands in the town of Amherst, county of Erie
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the discontinuance of certain parklands in the town of Amherst, county of Erie for lease to Bell Atlantic Mobile Systems, LLC d/b/a Verizon Wireless for the placement and operation of a wireless communications tower.
sponsored.fis: Financial impact will be positive in the form of a negotiated lease payment to the Town of Amherst from Verizon Wireless.

sponsored.t: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation
sponsored.sum: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation through the electric generation facility cessation mitigation fund for an additional three years.
sponsored.fis: None to the state, as additional appropriations have already been made to the fund.

sponsored.t: Enables safe access to public roads for all users by utilizing complete street design principles
sponsored.sum: Enables safe access to public roads for all users by utilizing complete street design principles.

sponsored.t: Relates to certifying instructors in small arms practice
sponsored.sum: Relates to certifying instructors in small arms practice; provides that after December 31, 2028 individuals certified as an instructor in small arms practice shall seek recertification subject to the standards and curriculum promulgated by the division of criminal justice services.

sponsored.t: Prohibits non-compete agreements and certain restrictive covenants
sponsored.sum: Prohibits non-compete agreements and certain restrictive covenants; authorizes covered individuals to bring a civil action in a court of competent jurisdiction against any employer or persons alleged to have violated such prohibition.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the use of funds, financial incentives or subsidies where facilities or property are used primarily for e-commerce storage and transfers, or the facilitation thereof
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting the use of funds, financial incentives or subsidies where facilities or property are used primarily for e-commerce storage and transfers, or the facilitation thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to delinquent tax interest rates
sponsored.sum: Relates to setting a minimum and maximum delinquent tax interest rate for payments due on residential real property.

sponsored.t: Establishes the vacant rental improvement program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the vacant rental improvement program to provide grants of up to $75,000 per unit to owners of buildings with five or fewer units.

sponsored.t: Establishes the block by block homeownership program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the block by block homeownership program to provide capital subsidies for the purpose of constructing, preserving, and rehabilitating one- to two- family dwellings throughout the state, outside of NYC.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "home utility weatherization jobs act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "home utility weatherization jobs act"; requires each gas corporation, electric corporation, or combination gas or electric corporation to submit to the public service commission for review and approval at least one and up to ten neighborhood scale weatherization and electrification-ready projects.

sponsored.t: Relates to non-Indian trespass and drug trafficking activities within Indian lands, and to criminal law enforcement activities within Seneca nation lands
sponsored.sum: Relates to intrusions upon lands owned or occupied by any nation, tribe or band of Indians, and to drug trafficking activities within Indian lands; provides that the district attorney of a county in which reservation lands are situated, upon application of a person designated by the laws of a nation, tribe or band to make such application, shall make complaint of intrusions on such lands and cause intruders to be removed; provides that the governor, the superintendent of state police, a sheriff of a county that includes lands of the Seneca nation, or the chief of police of the city of Salamanca, may, at the request of the Seneca nation, enter into an agreement with the Seneca nation…

sponsored.t: Requires the New York state public high school athletic association to establish a central committee, an executive committee, and state sport committees
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to promulgate rules and regulations requiring the New York state public high school athletic association to establish a central committee, an executive committee, and state sport committees.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing secondary bonding authority to the Buffalo fiscal stability authority
sponsored.sum: Provides secondary bonding authority up to $150,000,000 to the Buffalo fiscal stability authority during the period of July 1, 2025 and June 30, 2029.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring certain town and village justices be admitted to practice law in the state
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring certain town and village justices be admitted to practice law in the state; requires town and village justices in a town or village with a high arraignment volume be admitted to practice law in New York state for at least five years as of the date they commence the duties of office; provides the determination of a town or village with a high arraignment volume shall be made by the office of court administration in consultation with the division of criminal justice services.

sponsored.t: Relates to the motor vehicle exemption and the homestead exemption for certain money judgments and bankruptcy proceedings
sponsored.sum: Relates to the calculation of the homestead exemption amount; relates to the indexing of the homestead exemption for housing value changes; increases the amount of the motor vehicle exemption; limits the homestead exemption available to bankruptcy debtors to one exemption per household; increases the motor vehicle exemption available in bankruptcy proceedings.

sponsored.t: Relates to the caseloads of preventative services caseworkers
sponsored.sum: Relates to the caseloads of preventative services caseworkers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the practice of banning books by publicly funded libraries
sponsored.sum: Provides that publicly funded libraries may not ban books because of partisan or doctrinal disapproval; directs school districts to adopt the ALA library bill of rights.

sponsored.t: Relates to the imposition of additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes by Erie county
sponsored.sum: Extends the imposition of additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes by Erie county to November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Provides for the sale of municipal obligations by the county of Erie
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions providing for the sale of municipal obligations by the county of Erie.
sponsored.fis: Produces lower interest rates for the county of Erie in negotiating the sale of their bonds.

sponsored.t: Relates to the applicability of the residential redevelopment inhibited property exemption
sponsored.sum: Relates to expanding the applicability of the residential redevelopment inhibited property exemption to all cities, town, or villages in the state.

sponsored.t: Establishes certain contract requirements involving glazing work
sponsored.sum: Establishes certain contract requirements involving glazing work; provides that certain contracts over one million and five million dollars that include glazing work to be performed outside of a city with a population of one million or more shall require such work be performed by North American Contractor Certification ("NACC") certified companies; defines glazing work.

sponsored.t: Provides an exemption for certain fiber optic cable assessments in Erie county
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption for certain fiber optic cable assessments in Erie county.

sponsored.t: Establishes a continuing care retirement community bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Establishes a continuing care retirement community bill of rights; requires the commissioner of health to designate a county ombudsperson to monitor such bill of rights.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "city of Buffalo historic preservation receivership act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "city of Buffalo historic preservation receivership act"; provides the city of Buffalo specific procedures for the appointment of a receiver of rents in instances where the property at issue is neglected or abandoned.

sponsored.t: Relates to reviews by the authorities budget office
sponsored.sum: Relates to reviews by the authorities budget office; grants the authorities budget office the authority to commence an action or special proceeding to annul the corporate existence or dissolve a corporation that has acted beyond its capacity or power; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Grants peace officer status to the reserve deputies of the Erie county sheriff's office
sponsored.sum: Grants peace officer status to the reserve deputies of the Erie county sheriff's office.

sponsored.t: Relates to imposing certain restrictions on catalytic converters
sponsored.sum: Imposes certain restrictions on catalytic converters; requires all vehicle catalytic converters to be indelibly marked or engraved with a readily observable vehicle serial number; provides a reduction in premium charges for certain motor vehicle liability, comprehensive and collision insurance rates with respect to automobiles equipped with a catalytic converter which contains the vehicle identification number of the vehicle.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount of geothermal energy systems tax credits
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of geothermal energy systems tax credits.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the NY state and local employees' retirement system for Maureen Sullivan Nasca
sponsored.sum: Relates to granting retroactive Tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system for Maureen Sullivan Nasca.

sponsored.t: Relates to the promotion of local small businesses listed on the registry of historic businesses
sponsored.sum: Provides for the promotion of local small businesses listed on the registry of historic businesses as part of the "I Love NY" brand.

sponsored.t: Relates to revoking a license to carry, possess, repair and dispose of firearms for a conviction for failure to safely store rifles, shotguns, and firearms
sponsored.sum: Relates to revoking a license to carry, possess, repair and dispose of firearms for a conviction for failure to safely store rifles, shotguns, and firearms.

sponsored.t: Relates to waiver of privilege
sponsored.sum: Relates to waiver of privilege; provides for the scope of a waiver, inadvertent disclosure, and the effects of a court order and party agreement on waivers of privilege or protection.

sponsored.t: Requires the consideration of complete street design for certain transportation projects which receive federal or state funding
sponsored.sum: Requires the consideration of complete street design for certain transportation projects which receive federal or state funding; authorizes the department to compile and make publicly available guidance and reference material related to consideration of complete street design.

sponsored.t: Relates to waiving school taxes by a town, city, or county industrial development agency
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a town, city, or county industrial development agency from waiving taxes which would be received by a school district.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the exclusion of coverage for losses or damages caused by exposure to lead-based paint
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting the exclusion of coverage for losses or damages caused by exposure to lead-based paint; provides that no insurer licensed or permitted by the superintendent to provide liability coverage to rental property owners shall exclude coverage for losses or damages caused by exposure to lead-based paint.

sponsored.t: Relates to financial assistance from an industrial development agency; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions related to requiring projects be located in a highly distressed area in order to qualify for certain financial assistance from an industrial development agency.

sponsored.t: Relates to making restaurant and bar patios one hundred percent smoke free; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to making restaurant and bar patios one hundred percent smoke free.

sponsored.t: Authorizes recoupment of financial incentives awarded businesses upon failure to fulfill the terms of such incentive
sponsored.sum: Authorizes recoupment by the state or any political subdivision of financial incentives such as awards, loans, grants or tax abatements, awarded businesses for purposes of job training, job creation or retention, or the development of business operations, upon recipient's failure to complete the terms of the incentive.
sponsored.fis: An increase in tax revenues from employed workers and expanded oper- ations.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the New York state innovation voucher program
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state innovation voucher program; provides small businesses with access to research and development by colleges and universities, government laboratories and public research institutes in order to assist such businesses in the creation of innovative products or services.

sponsored.t: Relates to the shipment of alcoholic beverages into the state
sponsored.sum: Requires that alcoholic beverages imported into New York be first delivered to a licensed New York state wholesaler and maintained at a premises or warehouse operated by the wholesaler for a period of twenty-four hours.
sponsored.fis: Increased tax revenues for the State.

sponsored.t: Relates to small business savings accounts
sponsored.sum: Relates to small business savings accounts; provides tax incentives for contributions and distributions.
sponsored.fis: Approximately $20 million (dependent on how many eligibly small busi- nesses opt in).

sponsored.t: Authorizes cities and towns, except New York city, to establish community housing funds
sponsored.sum: Authorizes cities and towns, except a city with a population of one million or more, to establish community housing funds; authorizes such cities and towns to impose a real estate transfer tax with revenues to be deposited in such funds; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the payment of shelter and rent arrears
sponsored.sum: Relates to the payment of shelter and rent arrears; provides that all shelter arrears payments authorized for applicants to receive an emergency grant to pay for rent, property taxes or mortgage arrears shall be limited to once every year unless the district determines at its discretion that additional shelter arrears payments are necessary based on the individual circumstances.

sponsored.t: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits for certain sites
sponsored.sum: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits with respect to a site located within the Renaissance Commerce Park situate within the city of Lackawanna, Erie county.
